task.description: Write ExUnit tests covering Letflow.TenantProvisioning.replay_all_pending/0 (new) and Letflow.TenantProvisioning.MigrationReplayBoot (new), per WF-03's regression-test rule: since this fix ADDS new functions rather than changing existing behavior, the fail-then-pass rule is satisfied only via the MUTATION-TESTING path (see docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md, 'When the pre-fix failure is code under test does not exist' section) -- your tests must be proven SENSITIVE to the specific traps this fix exists to prevent, not merely passing against the shipped implementation. Cover at minimum: (1) idempotent no-op second run -- calling replay_all_pending/0 twice against tenants with zero pending migrations produces the same %{ok: [...], error: []} result both times with no duplicate DDL/rows; (2) one tenant's migration failure does not abort replay for other tenants -- construct a fixture where one tenant's migration state is broken (e.g. a corrupt/unreachable schema or a migration that raises) and confirm the OTHER tenants still get replayed and appear under :ok while the broken one appears under :error, in the same call; (3) a real replay against a genuinely pending tenant-scoped migration in a test fixture -- provision a tenant, then simulate a migration that was added AFTER provisioning (not yet applied to that tenant's schema), call replay_all_pending/0, and confirm it actually applies and the tenant ends up under :ok. Mutate the shipped implementation in at least 2 ways that target the specific traps this fix exists to handle (e.g. mutant 1: remove the per-tenant rescue in replay_all_pending/0's loop so one tenant's raise aborts the whole Enum -- confirm your test for (2) fails against this mutant; mutant 2: make MigrationReplayBoot.start_link/1 propagate an exception on total failure instead of always returning :ignore -- confirm this is a real risk your test suite would catch if introduced). Apply mutants in a throwaway git worktree of this branch (preferred) or apply-then-revert-and-verify in place per WF-03's isolation technique -- record which technique you used and the pass/fail counts for each mutant in result.summary. Do NOT implement the fix (already done, gated PASS through REVIEWER at step 05) -- test code only.
acceptance_criteria: Test file(s) exist covering: idempotent no-op second run, one tenant's failure doesn't abort others, real replay against a genuinely pending migration fixture

At least 2 mutants applied against the shipped implementation, targeting the isolation guarantee and the always-:ignore guarantee specifically, with recorded pass/fail counts proving the new tests are sensitive to each
Mutants reverted and the revert verified (git status --porcelain test/ lib/ empty, and the test file re-runs green against the restored unmutated code) -- state this explicitly in result.summary
No implementation code changed in the final committed state -- only test files
